name: grafana-dataviz
description: Repo-root install shim. The real pnpm workspace lives in ./plugins. This manifest exists only so tooling that installs at the repository root (e.g. grafana/plugin-actions/bundle-size, whose install step ignores its working-directory input) does not fail with ERR_PNPM_NO_PKG_MANIFEST. Day-to-day work happens in ./plugins.
